name: aidlc-ux
description: UI/UX pod for the AIDLC pipeline that starts from whatever already exists. Screens in Figma → implements them via the Figma MCP and gates on fidelity, jury optional. A brand design system in Figma → extracts its variables and components as the project's tokens and vocabulary, and still designs the screens within them. Neither → invents both: UX-narrative writer, Awwwards inspiration researcher, design-system owner (the uniformity anchor), motion/interaction specialist, and a strict unbiased jury that renders the UI and gates on a ≥9/10 score. New or existing projects, page or whole-app scope, honors supplied brand references (logo, colors, fonts). Bundles the Figma and Playwright MCP servers it needs, so a backend-only workspace installs neither.
